comments.author: George
comments.body:
I'm surprised no one has answered this on the Leadership page, itself, but when you face players in combat, you will sometimes encounter the Chaos condition. Chaos is a stronger form of Disorder, caused by Loud Sea Mines and perhaps another skill or two. The only way (to my knowledge) to cure it is a high Leadership rank. I've read that R8 Leadership has approximately a 10% chance to cure Chaos.

Likewise, there are other "Super" forms of conditions, like Flooding instead of Leaking, and one for Fire (that I don't remember the name for).

comments.author: DPiano
comments.body:
Some may think about this skill: "it's useless to rank up", let me say it's not.

Actually this skill is pretty useful for traders and maritime players.

1. For battle this skill cure DISORDER and it's super form, CHAOS, that it's harder to cure. The whole time I've been playing uwo only twice I had chaos status and it took more than 3 times the use of leadership skill to get rid of that status.

2. When sailing for long time without food, water or money, QUARRELING and it's super form, MUTINY, start to happen. Leadership can cure that state at any rank and almost just one use of the skill is enough to remove that state but the lower the rank, the lower the chance of a succesfully removed status; quarreling and mutiny can disappear easily but killing sailors the moment it's removed from your ship, the higher the rank, the better the results and more chance of successfully mediation without sailors dying.
